Bash(gh issue create --title "API: Packs Feature Implementation" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Overview
Implement pack management system including CRUD operations, member management, and permission enforcement.

## Phase
**Phase 2: Core Features** - Day 3 (Part 2)

## Objectives
- Build complete packs feature with member management
- Implement CRUD endpoints with permission checks
- Add member invite/remove functionality
- Calculate pack statistics (XP, level)
- Write comprehensive tests

## Endpoints
- POST /api/packs - Create new pack
- GET /api/packs/:id - Get pack details
- PATCH /api/packs/:id - Update pack (creator only)
- DELETE /api/packs/:id - Dissolve pack (creator only)
- POST /api/packs/:id/members - Add member to pack
- DELETE /api/packs/:id/members/:userId - Remove member
- GET /api/packs/:id/stats - Get pack statistics

## Implementation Tasks
1. Create feature folder structure with utils for permissions
2. Define types (Pack, PackMember, PackStats, CreatePackInput, UpdatePackInput)
3. Zod schemas for pack creation, updates, member operations
4. Services: createPack, getPack, updatePack, dissolvePack, addMember, removeMember, getPackStats
5. Permission utilities: checkPackCreator, checkPackMembership, validateMemberLimit
6. Route handlers with permission enforcement
7. Pack XP/level calculation logic

## Business Rules
- 3-10 member limit per pack
- Only creator can update/dissolve pack
- Can''t dissolve pack with active fines
- Pack XP = sum of member XP
- Pack level derived from collective XP

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All CRUD operations functional
- [ ] Permission enforcement (creator vs member)
- [ ] Member limit validation (3-10)
- [ ] Pack statistics calculated correctly
- [ ] Dissolution checks (no active fines)
- [ ] Comprehensive tests

## Estimated Time
**0.5 day** (4 hours)

## Dependencies
Requires: #73 (Users feature)

## Labels
`feature`, `packs`, `phase-2`
EOF
)")

Bash(gh issue create --title "API: Check-ins Feature Implementation" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Overview
Implement check-in system with streak tracking, XP awards, and feed generation - the core accountability mechanism.

## Phase
**Phase 3: Accountability Features** - Days 5-6

## Objectives
- Build check-in submission with proof handling
- Implement streak calculation algorithm
- Create XP award system with streak bonuses
- Generate feed across user''s packs
- Prevent duplicate check-ins
- Write comprehensive tests

## Endpoints
- POST /api/checkins - Submit check-in for goal
- GET /api/checkins/feed - Get user''s feed (all packs)
- GET /api/packs/:packId/checkins - Get pack check-ins
- GET /api/checkins/:id - Get check-in details
- POST /api/checkins/:id/verify - Verify check-in with proof

## Implementation Tasks
1. Create feature folder structure with utils for streak/XP
2. Define types (CheckIn, FeedItem, CreateCheckInInput, StreakResult)
3. Zod schemas for check-in submission
4. Services: submitCheckIn, getFeed, getPackCheckIns, verifyCheckIn
5. Streak calculation logic (consecutive days tracking)
6. XP award formula (base + streak bonus)
7. Level calculation from XP
8. Feed aggregation across packs
9. Duplicate prevention (one per goal per day)

## Business Logic

### Streak Calculation
- Reset to 1 if missed yesterday
- Increment by 1 if checked in yesterday
- Award bonus XP: base_xp * (1 + streak_count * 0.1)

### XP Award
- Base XP defined per goal
- Streak bonus: 10% per consecutive day
- Example: 100 base + 5 day streak = 150 XP total

### Level Calculation
- Level 1: 0 XP
- Level 2: 100 XP
- Level 3: 300 XP (100 + 200)
- Formula: level_n requires level_(n-1) + n * 100

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Check-in submission functional
- [ ] Duplicate prevention working
- [ ] Streak tracking accurate
- [ ] XP awards calculated correctly
- [ ] Level progression working
- [ ] Feed aggregates across packs
- [ ] Proof URL validation
- [ ] Comprehensive tests

## Estimated Time
**2 days** (12-16 hours)

## Dependencies
Requires: #75 (Goals feature)

## Labels
`feature`, `checkins`, `phase-3`, `core-logic`
EOF
)")

Bash(gh issue create --title "API: Fines & Voting Feature Implementation" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Overview
Implement democratic fine system with pack voting, consensus resolution, and punishment enforcement.

## Phase
**Phase 3: Accountability Features** - Day 7

## Objectives
- Build fine creation on missed check-ins
- Implement democratic voting system
- Create consensus resolution algorithm
- Handle appeals process
- Generate punishment records
- Create transaction placeholders (payment later)
- Write comprehensive tests

## Endpoints
- POST /api/fines - Create fine for missed check-in
- GET /api/fines/:id - Get fine details with vote count
- POST /api/fines/:id/vote - Cast vote (enforce/dismiss)
- POST /api/fines/:id/resolve - Manually resolve after voting window
- POST /api/fines/:id/appeal - Appeal fine decision
- GET /api/packs/:packId/fines - List pack fines

## Implementation Tasks
1. Create feature folder structure with voting utils
2. Define types (Fine, FineVote, VoteResult, CreateFineInput, VoteInput)
3. Zod schemas for fine creation and voting
4. Services: createFine, getFine, castVote, resolveFine, appealFine, listPackFines
5. Voting consensus algorithm
6. Auto-resolution after voting window
7. Punishment record creation on enforcement
8. Transaction placeholder creation

## Business Logic

### Voting Rules
- Only pack members can vote
- One vote per member
- Voting window: 24 hours from creation
- vote: true = enforce, false = dismiss

### Consensus Algorithm
```
enforceVotes = count(vote === true)
dismissVotes = totalVotes - enforceVotes

if (enforceVotes > dismissVotes):
  status = ''enforced''
  createPunishment(fine)
else:
  status = ''cancelled''
```

### Auto-Resolution
- Check voting_ends_at timestamp
- Resolve if window expired
- Can also manually trigger resolution

### Punishment Creation
- Type: ''fine''
- Amount: fine amount in cents
- Status: ''pending'' (until payment integration)
- Links to check_in_id

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Fine creation functional
- [ ] Voting system working
- [ ] One vote per member enforced
- [ ] Consensus algorithm correct
- [ ] Auto-resolution after 24 hours
- [ ] Punishment records created when enforced
- [ ] Appeal system functional
- [ ] Transaction placeholders created
- [ ] Comprehensive tests

## Estimated Time
**1 day** (6-8 hours)

## Dependencies
Requires: #76 (Check-ins feature)

## Labels
`feature`, `fines`, `voting`, `phase-3`, `core-logic`
EOF
)")
